buttonStates.protocol: Computer Use drag ended over the Replay button without starting on its hit area; the released pointer remained over the button before macOS lossless window capture.
The Computer Use action screenshot captured the transient pressed artwork and pointer during the Adobe Player click. It includes 28 pixels of player chrome and JPEG compression.

replayBehavior.observation: Immediately after clicking Replay, Adobe Player Control showed Pause, proving that the stopped root timeline resumed. After one 35-frame duration, Control showed Play, proving that it reached the terminal stop again.
replayBehavior.visualCaveat: All 35 root frames have the same stage hash, so playback progress is observable through the authoritative player run state rather than changing pixels.

limitations: The pressed button state is authoritative Adobe runtime evidence but is JPEG and therefore excluded from RMSE metrics.
A lossless native-stage capture of the transient pressed state is still required before this interaction can pass the strict visual gate without an accepted exception.
This standalone child SWF evidence does not prove parent-host variables, audio, localization, human review, or owner acceptance.
